description: This file contains utility functions and types for normalizing, canonicalizing, and validating security-related URL paths, including handling path encoding, prefix matching, and detection of anomalies in path canonicalization.

classes.name: SecurityPathCanonicalization
classes.description: Type representing the result of path canonicalization, including path candidates, decoding info, and anomalies.

methods.name: buildCanonicalPathCandidates
methods.description: Generates path candidates by decoding and normalizing the input path, tracking decoding passes and anomalies.

methods.name: canonicalizePathVariant
methods.description: Returns the last candidate path after canonicalization, or '/' if none.

methods.name: canonicalizePathForSecurity
methods.description: Returns a detailed canonicalization object for a given path, including candidates and anomalies.

methods.name: hasSecurityPathCanonicalizationAnomaly
methods.description: Checks if a path has encoding or decoding anomalies.

methods.name: isPathProtectedByPrefixes
methods.description: Determines if a path is protected by specified prefixes after canonicalization.

methods.name: isProtectedPluginRoutePath
methods.description: Checks if a path is a protected plugin route based on predefined prefixes.
